submission.justification: Crystal-K2 is recommended because it provides the best energy resolution among viable candidates. Crystal-K3 must be eliminated due to intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day, which exceeds the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day by a factor of 4. Between K1 and K2, Crystal-K2 has medium light yield compared to K1's lower light yield. Since energy resolution at 662 keV scales approximately with the square root of photoelectron statistics, higher light yield directly translates to better energy resolution - the primary goal. Crystal-K2's intrinsic background of 0.30 counts/kg/day comfortably meets the 0.5 counts/kg/day constraint. A thickness of 5 cm provides optimal balance between detection efficiency for 662 keV gammas and light collection efficiency, while remaining well within the 2-10 cm constraint.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K2 is explicitly listed as one of the three candidate crystals in candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution at 662 keV must be 5% or better
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K2 has medium light yield (superior to K1's lower light yield), which provides better energy resolution through improved photoelectron statistics. Higher light yield inorganic scintillators typically achieve <5% resolution at 662 keV with proper readout, which the DAQ system supports with 250 MS/s 14-bit ADCs

requirements.requirement: Intrinsic background (100-3000 keV) must not exceed 0.5 counts/kg/day
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K2 measured intrinsic background is 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day, which is below the 0.5 counts/kg/day facility budget (assay_campaign_2026Q1.md)
Recommended thickness of 5 cm is within the specified 2-10 cm range

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Among crystals meeting hard constraints (K1 and K2), Crystal-K2 has superior medium light yield vs K1's lower light yield, directly providing better energy resolution through improved photon statistics
